using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Garnet.client;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class FailoverSessionTests
    {
        // We test the BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync method indirectly by subclassing FailoverSession
        // and exposing the method as public for testing. We mock dependencies to trigger the LogCritical call.

        private class TestFailoverSession : FailoverSession
        {
            public TestFailoverSession(
                Mock<ILogger> loggerMock,
                Mock<GarnetClient> clientMock,
                string replicaId,
                byte[] configByteArray,
                Mock<IClusterProvider> clusterProviderMock)
            {
                this.logger = loggerMock.Object;
                this.primaryClient = clientMock.Object;
                this.clusterProvider = clusterProviderMock.Object;
                this.oldConfig = new ClusterConfigStub(replicaId);
                this.failoverTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);
                this.cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
                this.epoch = 0;
                this.status = FailoverStatus.NONE;
                this.replicaId = replicaId;
                this.configByteArray = configByteArray;
            }

            public ILogger logger;
            public GarnetClient primaryClient;
            public IClusterProvider clusterProvider;
            public ClusterConfigStub oldConfig;
            public TimeSpan failoverTimeout;
            public CancellationTokenSource cts;
            public int epoch;
            public FailoverStatus status;
            public string replicaId;
            public byte[] configByteArray;

            public async Task CallBroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync(string replicaId, byte[] configByteArray)
            {
                await BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync(replicaId, configByteArray);
            }
        }

        // Minimal stub for ClusterConfig to support IsKnown and LocalNodeId
        private class ClusterConfigStub
        {
            private readonly string _localNodeId;
            public ClusterConfigStub(string localNodeId)
            {
                _localNodeId = localNodeId;
            }
            public string LocalNodeId => _localNodeId;
            public string LocalNodeIp => "127.0.0.1";
            public int LocalNodePort => 1234;
            public string LocalNodePrimaryId => "primary";

            public bool IsKnown(string nodeId)
            {
                // For test, only known if nodeId equals localNodeId
                return nodeId == _localNodeId;
            }
        }

        // Minimal interface for clusterProvider to support clusterManager and replicationManager
        public interface IClusterProvider
        {
            IClusterManager clusterManager { get; }
            IReplicationManager replicationManager { get; }
        }

        public interface IClusterManager
        {
            ClusterConfigStub CurrentConfig { get; }
            IGossipStats gossipStats { get; }
            bool TryMerge(ClusterConfigStub config);
        }

        public interface IGossipStats
        {
            void UpdateGossipBytesRecv(int bytes);
        }

        public interface IReplicationManager
        {
            long ReplicationOffset { get; }
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync_LogsCriticalOnException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var clientMock = new Mock<GarnetClient>(MockBehavior.Strict, null, null, 0, 0, null, null, 0, null);
            var clusterManagerMock = new Mock<IClusterManager>();
            var gossipStatsMock = new Mock<IGossipStats>();
            var replicationManagerMock = new Mock<IReplicationManager>();
            var clusterProviderMock = new Mock<IClusterProvider>();

            var replicaId = "replica1";
            var configByteArray = new byte[] { 1, 2, 3 };

            // Setup clusterProvider and clusterManager
            clusterProviderMock.SetupGet(c => c.clusterManager).Returns(clusterManagerMock.Object);
            clusterProviderMock.SetupGet(c => c.replicationManager).Returns(replicationManagerMock.Object);

            // Setup clusterManager.CurrentConfig to return a stub with LocalNodeId = replicaId
            var currentConfig = new ClusterConfigStub(replicaId);
            clusterManagerMock.SetupGet(c => c.CurrentConfig).Returns(currentConfig);
            clusterManagerMock.SetupGet(c => c.gossipStats).Returns(gossipStatsMock.Object);

            // Setup client.GossipAsync to return a Memory<byte> that throws on ToArray to simulate exception
            clientMock.Setup(c => c.GossipAsync(It.IsAny<byte[]>()))
                .Returns(() =>
                {
                    // Return a Memory<byte> that throws on ToArray
                    var mem = new Memory<byte>(new byte[] { 1, 2, 3 });
                    return Task.FromResult(mem);
                });

            // Setup client.ReplicaOf to return "OK"
            clientMock.Setup(c => c.ReplicaOf(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<int>()))
                .ReturnsAsync("OK");

            // Setup TryMerge to return true
            clusterManagerMock.Setup(c => c.TryMerge(It.IsAny<ClusterConfigStub>())).Returns(true);

            // Setup replicationManager.ReplicationOffset
            replicationManagerMock.SetupGet(r => r.ReplicationOffset).Returns(0);

            // Setup oldConfig with LocalNodePrimaryId different from replicaId to force GetConnectionAsync call
            var oldConfigStub = new ClusterConfigStub("primary");

            // Create instance of TestFailoverSession
            var session = new TestFailoverSession(loggerMock, clientMock, replicaId, configByteArray, clusterProviderMock);
            session.oldConfig = oldConfigStub;

            // We want to simulate an exception inside the inner try block to trigger LogCritical
            // We do this by making ClusterConfig.FromByteArray throw when called inside BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync
            // But since we cannot override static methods, we simulate by making client.GossipAsync return a Memory<byte> that causes FromByteArray to throw

            // Instead, we will mock clusterManager.TryMerge to throw to simulate the exception caught and logged as critical
            clusterManagerMock.Setup(c => c.TryMerge(It.IsAny<ClusterConfigStub>())).Throws(new InvalidOperationException("Test exception"));

            // Act
            await session.CallBroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync(replicaId, configByteArray);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Critical,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("IssueAttachReplicas faulted")),
                    It.IsAny<InvalidOperationException>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class FailoverSessionTests
    {
        // We cannot subclass FailoverSession because it is internal sealed.
        // Instead, we test the logging behavior by invoking the private method via reflection.
        // We mock dependencies to cause the inner try block to throw and verify LogCritical is called.

        [Fact]
        public async Task BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync_LogsCriticalOnException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var clusterManagerMock = new Mock<IClusterManager>();
            var gossipStatsMock = new Mock<IGossipStats>();
            var replicationManagerMock = new Mock<IReplicationManager>();
            var clusterProviderMock = new Mock<IClusterProvider>();

            var replicaId = "replica1";
            var configByteArray = new byte[] { 1, 2, 3 };

            // Setup clusterProvider and clusterManager
            clusterProviderMock.SetupGet(c => c.clusterManager).Returns(clusterManagerMock.Object);
            clusterProviderMock.SetupGet(c => c.replicationManager).Returns(replicationManagerMock.Object);

            // Setup clusterManager.CurrentConfig to return a stub with LocalNodeId = replicaId
            var currentConfig = new ClusterConfigStub(replicaId);
            clusterManagerMock.SetupGet(c => c.CurrentConfig).Returns(currentConfig);
            clusterManagerMock.SetupGet(c => c.gossipStats).Returns(gossipStatsMock.Object);

            // Setup TryMerge to throw to simulate exception caught and logged as critical
            clusterManagerMock.Setup(c => c.TryMerge(It.IsAny<ClusterConfigStub>())).Throws(new InvalidOperationException("Test exception"));

            // Setup replicationManager.ReplicationOffset
            replicationManagerMock.SetupGet(r => r.ReplicationOffset).Returns(0);

            // Setup a GarnetClient mock with GossipAsync returning a Memory<byte>
            var clientMock = new Mock<GarnetClient>(MockBehavior.Strict, null, null, 0, 0, null, null, 0, null);
            clientMock.Setup(c => c.GossipAsync(It.IsAny<byte[]>())).ReturnsAsync(new Memory<byte>(new byte[] { 1, 2, 3 }));
            clientMock.Setup(c => c.ReplicaOf(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<int>())).ReturnsAsync("OK");
            clientMock.Setup(c => c.Dispose());

            // Create an instance of FailoverSession via reflection (internal sealed)
            var failoverSessionType = typeof(FailoverSession);
            var ctor = failoverSessionType.GetConstructor(System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance, null, Type.EmptyTypes, null);
            Assert.NotNull(ctor);
            var session = ctor.Invoke(null);

            // Set private fields via reflection
            SetPrivateField(session, "logger", loggerMock.Object);
            SetPrivateField(session, "primaryClient", clientMock.Object);
            SetPrivateField(session, "clusterProvider", clusterProviderMock.Object);
            SetPrivateField(session, "oldConfig", new ClusterConfigStub("primary"));
            SetPrivateField(session, "failoverTimeout", TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
            SetPrivateField(session, "cts", new CancellationTokenSource());

            // Get the private method BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync
            var method = failoverSessionType.GetMethod("BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            Assert.NotNull(method);

            // Act
            var task = (Task)method.Invoke(session, new object[] { replicaId, configByteArray });
            await task.ConfigureAwait(false);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Critical,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("IssueAttachReplicas faulted")),
                    It.IsAny<InvalidOperationException>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        private static void SetPrivateField(object obj, string fieldName, object value)
        {
            var field = obj.GetType().GetField(fieldName, System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            Assert.NotNull(field);
            field.SetValue(obj, value);
        }

        // Minimal stub for ClusterConfig to support IsKnown and LocalNodeId
        private class ClusterConfigStub
        {
            private readonly string _localNodeId;
            public ClusterConfigStub(string localNodeId)
            {
                _localNodeId = localNodeId;
            }
            public string LocalNodeId => _localNodeId;
            public string LocalNodeIp => "127.0.0.1";
            public int LocalNodePort => 1234;
            public string LocalNodePrimaryId => "primary";

            public bool IsKnown(string nodeId)
            {
                // For test, only known if nodeId equals localNodeId
                return nodeId == _localNodeId;
            }
        }

        // Minimal interfaces for clusterProvider to support clusterManager and replicationManager
        public interface IClusterProvider
        {
            IClusterManager clusterManager { get; }
            IReplicationManager replicationManager { get; }
        }

        public interface IClusterManager
        {
            ClusterConfigStub CurrentConfig { get; }
            IGossipStats gossipStats { get; }
            bool TryMerge(ClusterConfigStub config);
        }

        public interface IGossipStats
        {
            void UpdateGossipBytesRecv(int bytes);
        }

        public interface IReplicationManager
        {
            long ReplicationOffset { get; }
        }
    }
}
